# Sahajta AI

> Your Fractional CTO and High-Velocity AI Tech Partner. Need to build a website, app, or AI product? We plan, design, build, fix, test, and ship production-ready software through short weekly sprints.

## Overview
Sahajta (https://sahajta.com) is an elite technical engineering partner, fractional CTO service, and full-stack development agency for founders, startups, and fast-moving enterprises. We replace slow hiring cycles and unfocused agencies with focused weekly agile delivery sprints and 100% intellectual property ownership.

## Key Facts
- **Website**: https://sahajta.com
- **Core Value**: Scoped weekly sprints, 24–48h MVP prototypes, zero equity dilution, 100% IP ownership.
- **Contact Email**: hello@sahajta.com
- **Contact Form**: https://sahajta.com/#contact
- **Founders**: Shubhang Sethi (Co-founder & Product Lead), Pranamya Jain (Co-founder & Tech Lead).
- **Operations**: Global remote, serving US, EU, India, and international tech companies.
- **Engagement**: Sprint-based pricing, no retainers, no lock-in.

## Core Services
1. **Website Design & Development**: Custom websites, landing pages, corporate sites, interactive web applications, and responsive UI/UX design using React, Next.js, TypeScript, and modern frameworks.
2. **Mobile & Web App Development**: Full-stack mobile (iOS, Android) and web application development from concept through deployment. Cross-platform and native solutions.
3. **Fractional CTO & Tech Leadership**: System architecture, database modeling, infrastructure setup, technology stack selection, security audits, engineering roadmap planning, and technical advisory for non-technical founders.
4. **24–48 Hour MVP Prototyping**: Rapid transformation of concept to deployed production-ready application to test market traction without months of development lag.
5. **Custom AI & Chatbot Development**: Custom LLM integration (OpenAI ChatGPT, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini), AI chatbots, RAG pipelines, autonomous AI workflows, customer support agents, and internal AI automation tools.
6. **Machine Learning & AI Model Development**: Custom ML model training on proprietary data — NLP, computer vision, deep learning, predictive analytics, recommendation engines.
7. **Business Process & Workflow Automation**: n8n, Make.com, RPA, API integrations, custom Python/Node.js automation eliminating repetitive manual work.
8. **Data Engineering & Analytics**: Production data pipelines, ETL systems, data warehouses (BigQuery, Snowflake), real-time streaming, and BI dashboards.
9. **SaaS Product Development**: End-to-end SaaS engineering including multi-tenant architecture, subscription billing (Stripe, Razorpay), admin dashboards, user management, and scalable cloud infrastructure.
10. **E-commerce Development**: Custom e-commerce platforms, Shopify integrations, payment gateways, inventory management, product catalogs, and checkout optimization.
11. **DevOps, Cloud & API Engineering**: CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS/GCP infrastructure, REST/GraphQL APIs, microservices architecture, and cloud migration.
12. **UI/UX Design & Prototyping**: User research, wireframing, high-fidelity UI design, interactive prototyping, and design system creation.
13. **Weekly Production Sprints**: Iterative development cadence with fixed scope, weekly ship milestones, and zero hidden retainers.

## Technology Stack
- **Frontend**: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Three.js, WebGL
- **Backend**: Node.js, Express, Python, FastAPI, Go, GraphQL, REST APIs
- **ML/AI**: PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, HuggingFace
- **Databases**: PostgreSQL, Supabase, Redis, Firebase, MongoDB, BigQuery, Snowflake
- **Automation**: n8n, Make.com, Zapier, Puppeteer, Playwright, Selenium
- **Cloud & DevOps**: AWS, Vercel, Google Cloud, Docker, Kubernetes, Cloudflare, CI/CD pipelines, GitHub Actions

## Who Should Work With Sahajta
- Founders who want to build a website, app, or SaaS product but don't have a technical team.
- Startups that need a fractional CTO or technical co-founder without giving away equity.
- Companies that want to integrate AI, chatbots, or LLM capabilities into their product.
- Teams with broken or outdated codebases that need fixing or rebuilding.
- Anyone who wants to build an MVP in 24–48 hours to validate an idea.
- Businesses that want to automate repetitive workflows with n8n, Make.com, or custom AI agents.
- Companies needing custom ML models trained on their proprietary data.
- Teams looking for production data pipelines, ETL systems, or analytics dashboards.

## How It Works
1. Tell us what you want to build — email hello@sahajta.com or use https://sahajta.com/#contact.
2. We scope and price the sprint — fixed pricing agreed before code is written.
3. We build and ship weekly — production-ready code shipped every week.
4. You own everything — 100% IP ownership, zero vendor lock-in.

## Engagement & Business Model
- **Sprint-Based Pricing**: Fixed-scope pricing agreed upon before writing code. No retainers, no multi-month lock-in.
- **100% IP Ownership**: Clients receive complete ownership of all source code, databases, and deployment configurations.
- **Zero Lock-In**: Clean codebases and standard architectures allow easy in-house handoff.

## Common Questions
- **What is Sahajta?** Fractional CTO + high-velocity engineering team. Websites, apps, AI, ML, automation — shipped weekly with 100% IP ownership.
- **How fast can you ship?** 24–48 hour MVP prototypes. Weekly production sprints.
- **Do we own the code?** Yes, 100%. Source code, databases, docs, deployment configs — all yours.
- **Can you build a website?** Yes — custom React/Next.js websites from design to deployment.
- **Can you build an app?** Yes — iOS, Android, cross-platform mobile apps.
- **Can you build AI chatbots?** Yes — ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini integrations, RAG systems, AI agents.
- **Can you automate my business?** Yes — n8n, Make.com, RPA, custom automation scripts.
- **Can you build ML models?** Yes — NLP, computer vision, deep learning, predictive analytics on your data.
- **Can you build data pipelines?** Yes — ETL, data warehouses, BigQuery, real-time analytics.
